details.summary: This is a flawless, highly practical recipe that perfectly hits the nutritional targets and stylistic guidelines for the book without requiring a single edit.

dimensions.feedback: Excellent taste coherence. Lemon, oregano, parsley, and olive oil create a classic, bright Mediterranean flavor profile that perfectly complements the earthy black-eyed peas and fresh vegetables.
All ingredients are correctly accounted for in the instructions, and no unlisted ingredients are introduced.
Instructions are clear and complete for a no-cook assembly recipe. The steps logically separate the dressing preparation from the addition of the bulky ingredients.
Perfectly aligned with the Mediterranean style, utilizing extra-virgin olive oil, fresh lemon, oregano, and plenty of fresh vegetables.
The no-cook, tossing method is exactly what this raw vegetable and canned bean salad requires.
The nutrition values are highly plausible. The calories, protein, and carbohydrates align perfectly with the specified quantities of black-eyed peas and olive oil.
The title accurately reflects the main ingredients, and the intro provides a warm, practical, and claim-free context that fits the book's tone beautifully.
Highly appealing. It's a colorful, fresh, and appetizing dish that offers great texture and requires minimal effort.
Flawlessly answers both conditions. It relies on a high-fiber pulse for complex carbohydrates, extra-virgin olive oil for healthy fats, and delivers a robust vegetable presence.
Zero added sugar is truthful. The 23.4 g of carbohydrate comes entirely from high-quality sources (beans and vegetables), landing perfectly in the target window.
Fits the 'Snacks & Sides' chapter perfectly. It works excellently as an afternoon snack or a vegetable side, and the macros hit the tier targets spot-on.
Extremely practical. Slicing tomatoes, dicing cucumber, and rinsing canned beans will easily take less than 10 minutes from a cold start. All ingredients are common supermarket staples.
